text:
maria_cs: ACME trial goes live tomorrow morning. Can we produce a compact customer-facing "quickplay" they can paste into kickoff? Needs: pre-warmed capacity hint, cache key/TTL defaults, client batching + a tiny JS snippet, streaming fallback, top renewal-risk signals, and a 3-question feedback card. Keep it one short paragraph + 6 bullets max. cc @sam_cs @vin_devex

sam_cs: love that framing. one-paragraph intro then 6 bullets. short + non-technical. :checkered_flag:

vin_devex: Suggested customer paragraph (editable): "We recommend a few lightweight defaults to keep responses fast and reliable: use tenant-scoped cache keys, keep recent completions cached briefly, enable small client-side batching for concurrent users, prefer streaming for chat UX with a polling fallback, and enable pre-warmed capacity during your first 72 hours to minimize cold starts."

vin_devex: Bullet drafts (for the checklist):
1) Cache keys: use tenant:user or tenant:session + prompt_hash so cache is isolated.
2) TTLs: completions = 10 minutes default; ephemeral session state = 60 seconds.
3) Stale strategy: serve cached response immediately, refresh async for UX <200ms.
4) Batching: client batch size 3-6 for low-latency apps; increase to 12+ for heavy throughput.
5) Streaming: prefer SSE/HTTP2. If streaming fails or queue latency >500ms, fall back to short-polling.
6) Pre-warmed capacity: enable for first 72h of ramp or during demos.

alex_sre: Minor wording tweak for external doc: replace "pre-warmed capacity" with "pre-provisioned capacity"? either works, but keep it customer-friendly. Also add ops knobs as an optional note (not in the 6 bullets).

sam_cs: Renewal-risk signals to surface to AE/CS (one-line each):
- p95 latency >1s on customer routes -> action: enable pre-provisioned capacity or reduce batch latency.
- Monthly tokens down >40% vs baseline -> action: outreach + usage review.
- Regressions on eval prompts (3+ failures) -> action: rollback model/verify prompt change.
- Warm-capacity disabled or frequent quota saturation -> action: re-enable reserve or adjust quotas.

jordan_eng: Client JS snippet for the kickoff paste (tiny):
```js
// enable streaming with polling fallback and batching toggle
async function generate(payload){
  const res = await fetch('/api/generate?stream=1', {method:'POST', body:JSON.stringify(payload)});
  if (!res.ok) return pollUntilComplete(payload);
  for await (const chunk of sseReader(res.body)) processChunk(chunk);
}
window.RW_BATCH_SIZE = 6; // default customer-friendly
```

jordan_eng: Streaming fallback note: if your SDK sees repeated 5xx or >500ms queue, switch to incremental polling using checkpoint tokens to append output reliably.

lucy_pm: Feedback card + Slack paste (3 Qs):
Card copy: "1) What were you trying to do? 2) Did the result help? (yes/partly/no) 3) Any short example of the output?"
Slack paste: `Hey <customer>, quick 30s ask: could you answer 3 Qs about the trial? [link to card]`

metrics-bot: example metric SQL to detect usage drop:
```sql
SELECT customer_id, (current_month_tokens - previous_month_tokens)/previous_month_tokens AS pct_change
FROM usage
WHERE customer_id = 'acme' AND (current_month_tokens < previous_month_tokens * 0.6);
```

vin_devex: Ops SDK tip for customers: include a one-line toggle for batch size and streaming: `window.RW_BATCH_SIZE = 6; window.RW_STREAM = true;` We can also provide a tiny paste-and-run script if they want.

maria_cs: This is perfect. I'll turn Vin's paragraph + the 6 bullets into the one-pager and add Lucy's feedback card link. Will drop into the kickoff doc and paste to ACME. If any phrasing issues for customer-facing, flag within the hour.

alex_sre: no phrasing issues from infra side. :thumbsup:

sam_cs: I'll also attach the renewal-signal action mapping in the kickoff thread for the AE.

maria_cs: thanks team — publishing in 30m.
